title: The Long Walk
subtitle: A vanilla statistic
description: A stat task watches one vanilla statistic and completes when it reaches `value`. This one watches `minecraft:walk_one_cm` and wants fifty thousand of them — five hundred blocks, counted by the game's own ledger rather than by the quest book.
Statistics are registry entries, so the validator can check the id; a statistic this build does not have counts as zero rather than failing the load.
